questions.question: What is the name of the full-system integration and ground-testing platform inaugurated to support SARAS Mk-2 aircraft development?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Iron Bird facility.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh inaugurated the Iron Bird facility at CSIR–NAL to support testing of the SARAS Mk-2 aircraft.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Iron Bird facility enables full-system integration testing for the SARAS Mk-2 light transport aircraft.**
 
• It is designed to reduce flight-test risks by identifying and resolving system issues on the ground.
 
• The platform helps shorten development timelines by enabling extensive ground-based evaluations.
 
• It supports testing of avionics, hydraulics, flight-control systems and structural interactions for SARAS Mk-2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **SARAS Mk-2**__

 __
 
• 19-seater light transport aircraft for civil and military use.
 
• Designed to support UDAN regional connectivity.
 
• Features include a pressurised cabin, digital avionics and glass cockpit.
 
• Developed to reduce reliance on foreign-made small aircraft.
 
 
 
• **HAP (High Altitude Platform) Facility**__
 __
 
• For building solar-powered unmanned aircraft capable of flying above 20 km.
 
• First full-scale flight planned for 2027.
 
• Supports surveillance, communication and environmental monitoring roles.
 
 
 
• **NAviMet System**__
 
 
• CSIR-NAL’s aviation weather system launched at HAL Airport.
 
• Used for real-time weather observation and reporting.
 
• Part of a broader ecosystem including DRISHTI and AWOS for civil and defence airfields.

questions.question: Recently, External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar warned of a rising bioterrorism threat at the 50th anniversary conference of the Biological Weapons Convention (BWC). The BWC is built on which of the following international protocols?
questions.solution:
Correct Answer: B) 1925 Geneva Protocol

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

EAM S. Jaishankar called for strengthening global biosecurity at the BWC’s 50th anniversary conference held in New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Biological Weapons Convention (BWC) forms the cornerstone of the global ban on biological and toxin weapons.
 
• The convention is historically rooted in the *1925 Geneva Protocol*, which prohibited the use of chemical and biological weapons during war.
 
• At the conference, India highlighted gaps in the BWC framework — lack of compliance mechanisms, technical bodies, and systems to track new scientific advances.
 
• Jaishankar stressed rising risks from genome editing, synthetic biology, and AI-driven biological design.
 
• He emphasised stronger biosecurity for the Global South and India's contributions in biotechnology, vaccines, labs (BSL-3 & BSL-4), and global health support.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The BWC prohibits development, production, acquisition, stockpiling, transfer, and use of biological and toxin weapons.
 
• India is a member of major non-proliferation regimes including the Wassenaar Arrangement, MTCR, and Australia Group.
 
• The 1925 Geneva Protocol was the first international treaty banning chemical and biological weapons in warfare.

questions.question: Who won the 2025 Formula One World Championship?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lando Norris.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Lando Norris was crowned the 2025 Formula One World Champion after the Abu Dhabi season finale.**
 
• **Despite Max Verstappen winning the race, Norris secured enough points with a P3 finish to take the title.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lando Norris became World Champion for the first time in 2025.**
 
• He races for McLaren and finished third in the final race to secure the championship.
 
• McLaren also sealed the Teams' Championship this season.
 
• The title marks McLaren’s first drivers’ championship in over a decade.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Max Verstappen**__ won the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2025 but missed the championship despite his fifth Yas Marina victory.
 
• __**Oscar Piastri**__ finished second in the final race, playing a key strategic role for McLaren.
 
• Charles Leclerc and George Russell fought behind, but couldn’t influence the title outcome.
 
• Norris overcame a season setback including a DNF at Zandvoort where he trailed by 34 points earlier.

questions.question: What is the new FDI limit approved by the Union Cabinet in the Insurance Amendment Bill, 2025 for insurance companies in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**100%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Union Cabinet approved the Insurance Amendment Bill, 2025, raising the FDI limit in insurance companies from 74% to 100%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The move aims to attract greater foreign capital, enhance competition, and improve service quality in the insurance sector.**
 
• **The reform supports technology infusion, modernisation, and the adoption of global best practices in insurance services.**
 
• **India’s insurance sector is governed by the Insurance Act, 1938, LIC Act, 1956, and IRDAI Act, 1999, all of which will undergo significant amendments.**
 
• **The FDI cap has gradually increased from 26% to 49%, then 74% in 2021, and now to 100%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• FDI Liberalisation in Insurance__

 __
 
• FDI limit has been gradually increased to 100%, opening doors for greater foreign investment.
 
• The previous limits were 26% (initial), 49%, and 74% (2021), now reaching 100% for full liberalisation.
 
 
 
• National Vision for Insurance__
 __
 
• Supports the national goal of "Insurance for All by 2047," aiming to expand insurance accessibility across the country.
 
• Aligns with long-term financial inclusion strategies and national economic growth initiatives.
 
 
 
• Insurance Sector Governance__
 
 
• India’s insurance sector is regulated by the Insurance Act, 1938, LIC Act, 1956, and IRDAI Act, 1999.
 
• Amendments to these acts will facilitate smoother operations and encourage foreign participation in the insurance market.

questions.question: 4th December marks the celebration of International Cheetah Day. What is the IUCN status of the cheetah?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vulnerable.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **International Cheetah Day is observed annually on 4th December to raise global awareness about cheetah conservation, with the species listed as ‘Vulnerable’ on the IUCN Red List.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **IUCN status of the cheetah is ‘Vulnerable’ due to declining global populations.**
 
• **Only around 7,100–7,500 cheetahs are left in the wild.**
 
• **Threats include habitat loss, human-wildlife conflict, and poaching.**
 
• **International Cheetah Day was established in 2010 by Dr. Laurie Marker in memory of Khayam.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **International Cheetah Day**__

 __
 
• Celebrated on 4 December every year.
 
• Aims to increase awareness about cheetah conservation needs.
 
• Date chosen as Khayam’s birthday — a cheetah nurtured by Dr. Laurie Marker.
 
 
 
• **Cheetah (Acinonyx jubatus)**__
 __
 
• Fastest land animal — can reach 75 mph in short bursts.
 
• Notable for black tear-like facial stripes aiding in hunting under sunlight.
 
• Primarily diurnal hunters relying on their sharp vision.
 
 
 
• **Conservation Efforts**__
 __
 
• Habitat protection and anti-poaching measures are key strategies.
 
• Human-wildlife conflict mitigation increases survival rates.
 
• India launched the International Big Cat Alliance in 2023 to protect 7 big cat species.
 
 
 
• **Dr. Laurie Marker & CCF**__
 
 
• Founded the Cheetah Conservation Fund in 1990.
 
• Instrumental in raising global awareness for cheetah survival.

questions.question: As of December 2025, the Centre has disbursed over ₹4 lakh crore through 21 instalments since the inception of the PM-KISAN scheme. What type of scheme is PM-KISAN, and how much annual support is provided per eligible farmer family?

options.text: A centrally sponsored scheme; ₹4,000 per year

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A central sector scheme; ₹6,000 per year.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Centre has disbursed over ₹4 lakh crore under the PM-KISAN scheme through 21 installments since its launch.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme__ launched on 24 February 2019.**
 
• **Provides direct income support of __₹6,000 annually__ per eligible farmer family.**
 
• **The amount is paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each every four months.**
 
• **Funds are transferred directly to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts via DBT.**
 
• **Over 11 crore farmer families have benefited so far, with more than 25% being women farmers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Eligibility**__

 __
 
• Farmers must have cultivable land in their name verified through state land records.
 
• Must complete e-KYC and provide correct bank details.
 
• Exclusions: institutional landholders, high-income professionals, and government employees.
 
 
 
• **Recent Installments**__
 __
 
• 21st installment released on 19 November 2025 from Coimbatore: ~₹18,000 crore to ~9 crore farmers.
 
• 20th installment released on 2 August 2025 from Varanasi: ~₹20,500 crore to 9.7 crore beneficiaries.
 
 
 
• **Access**__
 
 
• Farmers can register or check status via **pmkisan.gov.in**, CSCs, and PACS.
 
• Digital tools like e-KYC and the PM-KISAN portal ensure transparent verification and timely transfers.

questions.question: Who was sworn in as the new Chief Information Commissioner (CIC) of India in December 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Raj Kumar Goyal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Raj Kumar Goyal has been sworn in as the Chief Information Commissioner of India at Rashtrapati Bhavan, with President Droupadi Murmu administering the oath.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Goyal is a retired 1990-batch IAS officer of the AGMUT cadre and has previously served as Secretary in the Ministry of Law and Justice and Home Ministry.**
 
• **His appointment was recommended by a three-member committee headed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.**
 
• **The CIC post had been vacant since former CIC Heeralal Samariya demitted office in September 2025.**
 
• **With his appointment, the Central Information Commission regains leadership and is expected to return to near full strength with new Information Commissioners.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Central Information Commission (CIC)**__

 __
 
• A statutory body established under the Right to Information Act, 2005, to address complaints from individuals unable to obtain information from public authorities.
 
• Comprises one Chief Information Commissioner and up to ten Information Commissioners, appointed by the President on the recommendation of a committee.
 
 
 
• **Oath of Office**__
 __
 
• The oath to the CIC is administered by the President of India.
 
• President Droupadi Murmu administered the oath to Raj Kumar Goyal.
 
 
 
• **Past Women CICs**__
 __
 
• Deepak Sandhu (fourth CIC overall) and Sushma Singh (fifth CIC overall) have served as Chief Information Commissioners.
 
 
 
• **Significance**__
 
 
• Ensures smooth functioning of the Central Information Commission.
 
• Strengthens transparency and accountability under the Right to Information Act.

questions.question: Which city topped India's pollution chart in November 2025, according to the Centre for Research on Energy and Clean Air report?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghaziabad.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **A think tank report found Ghaziabad to be the most polluted city in India in November 2025.**
 
• **It topped the pollution chart among the top 10 polluted cities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghaziabad recorded a monthly average PM2.5 concentration of 224 µg/m³.**

questions.solution:

• **The Charaichung Festival 2025 was held in Majuli, focusing on reviving the historic Royal Bird Sanctuary established in 1633.**

questions.question: Which organisation successfully organised Vigyanika: Science Literature Festival 2025 as part of the India International Science Festival (IISF)?
